notes: Photo-first redesign: Home sizes rounded portraits by the number of people (one large square, two side-by-side cards, three or more a two-column grid), with a plain Settings action and no generic "Tap to call" line. All four call screens put the photo on top, name/status/timer below, and controls in one rounded tray. Large-font layouts adapt instead of clipping, and the ended-call photo is smaller so the result always fits.
